acceptedClaims: In this materially different Finance workload, owner-native source state, the model-visible selected view, and authority to choose that view are causally distinct.
A static caller heuristic based on recency is not an adequate substitute for task-relative source selection: it answered only 3 of 6 calibration tasks while FULL and AGENT answered all 6.
Agent-authored selection preserved all evaluated answers and selected the predeclared required owner source in every calibration and scale task while exposing much less domain-source content.
Selection has a fixed implementation cost: with the six-source base pool the two-stage AGENT treatment used more Provider tokens and twice the Model Calls of FULL.

Context-growth cost can dominate that fixed cost: with two large real Finance schema distractors the AGENT treatment used about half the total Provider tokens of FULL while preserving accuracy; the gap widened at larger tested pools.
Experiment campaign evidence must be committed incrementally: a late Provider disconnect must not erase earlier completed observations or authorize blind campaign replay.
rejectedClaims: Two-stage select-then-answer Model Calls are the universal or preferred implementation of Agent selection authority.
Two distractor sources are a universal crossover threshold; the observed crossover depends on source sizes, catalog representation, model, cache behavior, task, and Provider economics.
Agent selection is always cheaper or faster; the smallest tested pool was more token-expensive and this experiment did not establish lower wall-clock latency.
Finance should copy Harness WorkingSet or Memory primitives into its domain model.
FULL context is incorrect; it remained accurate in every evaluated task, but its information and token cost grew with irrelevant source content.
The experiment authorizes investment decisions, account actions, or any external financial effect.

projectImplications.question: When Finance research spans a growing owner-native source world, which source discovery/catalog/query surfaces let the Primary Agent choose task-relevant evidence without making ContextCompiler or a caller own semantic relevance?

How should Agent-owned WorkingSet/source selection consume large catalogs or retrieval surfaces while preserving exact provenance and recovery without requiring callers to preassemble full model-visible context?
Which experiment records must commit independently so campaign-level transient failure cannot erase accepted step evidence, and when should that become a shared research-method rule?
